scope: Cutoff-47 lower-bound screen of the eleven two-mode principal-submap drops obtained by deleting mode 11 and one other mode from the q96 F8 hyperoval map. All maps validate LP=I and deletion closure. Every known-order lower bound is above 1/sqrt(2); the best pair (11,10) is 0.7100574, above the completed q94 pressure 0.7100458. Pairs not containing mode 11, larger deletions, coordinate substitutions and complete profiles are outside this screen. No score, uniform transfer, or complete certificate is claimed.
